title: OpenStax Prealgebra 2e, 6.4 Solve Simple Interest Applications: Use the simple interest formula
summary: OpenStax Prealgebra 2e, 6.4 Solve Simple Interest Applications: Use the simple interest formula
body: OpenStax Prealgebra 2e, section "6.4 Solve Simple Interest Applications", prints these objectives: "Use the simple interest formula" "Solve simple interest applications". The section text says: "Do you know that banks pay you to let them keep your money? The money you put in the bank is called the principal , P , and the bank pays you interest , I . The interest is computed as a certain percent of the principal; called the rate of interest , r . The rate of interest is usually expressed as a percent per year, and is calculated by using the decimal equivalent of the percent. The variable for time, t , represents the number of years the money is left in the account." This card reports that page. The objectives are the book's learning statements, not a separate proof.
